Shift ke beech me jab bhi 2 minute mile, counter ke sahare ye karo:

Dehydration se sar dard aur thakaan hoti hai, to paani free hai, sharam mat karo.

## SFA Food Safety Advisory — Garmi me khana sambhal kar rakho

**From:** SG Food Agency Broadcast  
**Date:** Monday, 7 Sep 2026

Dear Food Handlers,

Bahar ka temperature zyada hai, isliye cooked food jaldi kharab ho raha hai. Sab stall please ye 3 baat pakki follow karo:

### 1. Paka khana 2 ghante se zyada bahar mat rakho
Paka hua rice, chicken, soup agar counter par 2 ghante se zyada pada hai to use discard karo. Thanda karke fridge me rakho.

### 2. Soup ko beech-beech me ubalo
Chicken soup aur stock ko din me baar-baar achche se ubalo. Sirf halka garam karna kaafi nahi hai — full boil aana chahiye.

### 3. Ice box aur chiller ka dhakkan band rakho
Kachcha samaan nikalte time baar-baar door khula mat chhodo. Ice box ka dhakkan tight band karo, temperature 4°C se neeche rakho.

Pet kharab ki complaint aayi to stall ka naam kharab hota hai. Garmi wale din thodi extra savdhani rakho.

**Food Safety & Hygiene Team**

- Emergency ho to 995 par call karo

### Chhota Chart - Yaad Rakho

**Chhota laal nishan ->** Thanda pani + gel, kaam continue  
**Chhala ya safed chamdi ->** Pani + first-aid + clinic  
**Kapde me aag ya bada jalna ->** Pani + 995 + supervisor ko turant bolo

Poster kal sab stall ke peeche lag jayega.

Safe raho, saath ka dhyan rakho.

body:
## SFA Food Safety - September Hygine Refresher

Namaste food handlers,

Is mahine ka chhota refresher - teen cheez jo inspection me sabse zyada pakdi jaati hai.

### 1. Chicken storage - 4C se neeche

Raw chicken hamesha chiller me **4C se neeche** rakho. Fridge ka darwaza baar-baar kholne se temperature badh jaata hai. Subah ek baar check karo aur thermometer reading likh do.

Marinated chicken ko neeche wali tray me rakho, cooked chicken kabhi uske neeche mat rakho - drip se cross-contamination hota hai.

### 2. Cooked rice - 2-hour rule yaad rakho

Paka hua chawal agar bahar hai to **2 ghante ke andar** ya to serve karo ya wapas chiller me daalo. Raat ka bacha rice subah garam karke mat becho. Rice cooker ka lid baar-baar kholna bandh karo, steam me bacteria control me rehta hai.

### 3. Thermometer log bhoolna nahi

Roz subah aur shaam ko chiller aur cooker ka temperature copy me likhna hai. Khali chhod doge to audit me fail ho jaoge. Pen khatam ho gaya hai to supervisor se naya le lo.

Saaf haath, saaf counter, safe khana.

**SFA Food Safety Team**  
[Food safety guide padho](https://www.sfa.gov.sg/food-safety)

## MOM Kitchen Safety Update - Garam Tel Se Bach Kar

Pyare food court helpers,

Is hafte ka safety update **fryer aur garam tel** ko lekar hai, please dhyaan se padh lena.

### 1. Fryer Se Distance Bana Kar Rakho

Tel ubal raha ho tab chehra aur haath door rakho, chhinta door se bhi jal sakta hai. Kadahi me geela samaan ekdum se mat dalo, pehle paani achche se jhadne do.

Garam tray ya tokri uthate time **heat gloves** zaroor pehno, geele kapde se mat pakdo. Pair me slip-proof joota pehno taaki tel wale floor par pair na fisle.

### 3. Jal Jaye To Pehle Thanda Paani

Agar haath jal jaye to turant **10 min tak saaf thanda paani** me rakho, baraf ya tel-colgate mat lagao. Chhala bada ho ya dard kam na ho to clinic ja kar dikha lo.

**Nayi safety poster** aa gayi hai, please apne **stall me peeche wali दीवार par laga lo** taaki sabko dikhe.

## Raat Ko Choohe-Cockroach Se Bachne Ka Checklist

Namaste stall operators aur helpers,

NEA ki routine check me kai food courts me raat ko khula khana aur geele floor ki complaint mili hai. Choohe aur cockroach raat ko hi nikalte hain. Isliye har stall ko aankh band karke ye teen kaam karne hain.

**Yaad rakho — safai ka matlab sirf jhaadu nahi, band karna hai:**

- **Dustbin hamesha dhak kar rakho** — khula bin mat chhodo, liner roz badlo, extra kachra floor par mat rakho
- **Khana khula mat chhodo** — bacha rice, chicken, sambal sab air-tight dabbe me fridge me rakho, counter par kuch khula na ho
- **Back area me paani jama na hone do** — sink ke neeche, ice box ke paas aur drain ke aas-paas paani pochh kar sukha rakho

### Ek Page Wala Night Checklist

Closing se pehle 5 minute me ye tick kar lo:

- [ ] Saare dustbin dhake hue aur liner tied
- [ ] Counter aur chopper board pochha aur dry
- [ ] Bacha khana labelled dabbe me fridge me
- [ ] Grease trap saaf aur dhaka hua
- [ ] Floor ka paani pocha, drain jaam nahi
- [ ] Back door band, kachra corridor me nahi

Poora poster yahan se download karke stall ke pichhe chipka lo: [Night Closing Checklist PDF](https://nea.gov.sg/clean-safe/night-checklist)

Agar lagatar teen baar khula bin ya khula khana mila to demo point kat sakta hai. Doubt ho to apne supervisor se pooch lo.

Saaf rakho, safe rakho,
